bullets.text: Involved in the backend development of the application, which focuses on addressing code errors and resolving issues by leveraging OpenAI GPT models through API integration.
Assisting in the development of an application that takes a GitHub repository as input, generates a runme file, and automatically identifies errors, resolving them.
Actively contributing to the development of a comprehensive coding tool, with a focus on enhancing issue resolution, code quality, and addressing bugs/issues..
The project aims to detect specific hand signs (LiveLong, ThankYou, ThumbsUp, and ThumbsDown) and then accurately draw bounding boxes around them.
The model exhibited exceptional accuracy in detecting and distinguishing the four designated signs.
A Transfer Learning approach is employed for model training, utilizing the ssd mobilenet v2 fpnlite 320x320 coco17 tpu-8 model.
The model is developed to perform sentiment analysis on movies based on provided reviews
Word2Vec was used in the development of this model with an artificial neural network (ANN) architecture.
The model achieved impressive accuracy rates of for 86.98% training data and 86.36% for test data.
Developed a waste management Deep Learning model employing CNN architectures.
Designed a high-performing model for precise classification of organic and recyclable waste
Employing MobileNet-V2 for transfer learning, the model achieved remarkable accuracy: 90.73% on the training data and 84.44% on the test data.

MSME Idea Hackathon 2.0: One of my notable achievements is representing our college Incubation Centre AIC-IIITKottayam at the national level in the MSME Idea Hackathon 2.0, a government-organized event focusing on idea submissions for startup initiatives.
SIH2023 : The winner of the SIH 2023 Internal Hackathon tackled the problem statement on sentiment analysis of incoming calls at the help desk.
